summary: Peabody Energy filed a Form 8-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting. Stockholders voted to elect ten directors, approved executive compensation on an advisory basis, ratified the 2026 Incentive Plan, and ratified Ernst & Young as auditor. All votes were routine and passed with large majorities. The filing is a standard current report on director elections and shareholder votes; no special-situation event such as an acquisition, activist campaign, or management departure is present.
